name: scrollsim2-ink
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Four long strips of the same stretch of a synthetic sheet, flattened: black random Greek capitals on white as the ink truth; gray CT on the sheet's face with ink, where the letters are faint; the same place in the twin rendered without ink; and the difference of the two, where the letters stand out in orange.
caption: Synthetic demo: the ScrollSim v2 ink writer on a flattened stretch of the recto face, with its noink twin and their difference. Random letters, not text; not a reading. No scan data.
